SA.description: Soil profile SA: hard rock (vs above 1500 m/s)

SC.description: Soil profile SC: very dense soil and soft rock (vs 360-760 m/s)

SD.description: Soil profile SD: stiff soil (vs 180-360 m/s)

SE.description: Soil profile SE: soft soil (vs below 180 m/s)

SF.description: Soil profile SF: soils needing a site-specific evaluation

siteSpecificStudy.warning: Soil profile {classes}: {code} {clause} requires a site-specific evaluation. Until one is made, Ca and Cv are those of profile {assumed}: an assumption, not a value of the code.

sources.designSpectrum: NSCP 2015 Sec 208.4.4, Tables 208-7 and 208-8 (Na, Nv: Tables 208-5 and 208-6): Ca and Cv by soil profile and Z (the UBC 1997 Tables 16-Q and 16-R values), x Na and Nv in the zone of Z = 0.4 (near-source factors by the seismic source type and distance); Sec 208.5.2: V = Cv I W/(R T) <= 2.5 Ca I W/R, >= 0.11 Ca I W (0.044 x 2.5 Ca), and in Z = 0.4 V >= 0.8 Z Nv I W/R; the design spectrum 2.5 Ca from T0 = 0.2 Ts to Ts = Cv/(2.5 Ca), Cv/T beyond, Ca at T = 0; T from the structure at most 1.4 Ta (1.3 Ta in Z = 0.4)
sources.periodCoefficients: NSCP 2015: T = Ct hn^(3/4), Ct 0.0853 steel moment frames, 0.0731 concrete moment frames and eccentrically braced frames, 0.0488 others (hn in m)
sources.systems: NSCP 2015 Tables 208-11A and 208-11B: R and Omega0 of the UBC 1997 Table 16-N rows SAEngine designs; Cd = 0.7 R (SAEngine practice for Delta_M = 0.7 R Delta_S); the height limits of zones 3 and 4 in the category D column (160 ft = 48.8 m, 240 ft = 73.2 m)
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: UBC-form codes have no Seismic Design Category; the zone takes the category whose detailing the code asks (zones of Z below 0.15: B ordinary, Z 0.15-0.2: C intermediate, Z 0.3 and 0.4: D special)
sources.allowableDrift: NSCP 2015 Sec 208.6.5: Delta_M <= 0.020 h for T >= 0.7 s (the 0.025 h of shorter periods not used: SAEngine practice, on the safe side)
